name: gitlab-official-docs
instructions: The official documentation of GitLab CI/CD, kept locally: the folder doc/ci of the GitLab documentation (.gitlab-ci.yml and the reference of every keyword), GitLab Runner, the Dev Containers CLI and glab, the GitLab CLI. Search with search_docs, then read one section with read_doc. Look it up rather than guess it.
search: Search the official documentation of GitLab CI/CD: .gitlab-ci.yml and its keywords, variables, cache, artifacts, rules, pipelines, GitLab Runner and its executors, the Dev Containers CLI, and every glab command (ci, mr, issue, release, variable...). Returns 10 section ids at most.
